newsitem.title: FRANCE: French prefer left but few expect them to win - poll.
newsitem.headline: French prefer left but few expect them to win - poll.

text.p: More French people would prefer the opposition left to win a May 25/June 1 parliamentary election than the ruling coalition but a majority expect the centre-right to retain power, according to an IFOP poll published in French weekly L'Express on Wednesday.
The poll of 1,000 people conducted on May 3 showed 46 percent wanted the opposition left to win while 44 percent wanted the ruling coalition to stay in power.
The percentage in favour of the left was up two percentage points since a previous April 25 poll while the proportion of those polled in favour of the centre-right was unchanged.
However 60 percent said they expected the centre-right coalition to win the election while 26 percent expected the opposition left to get a majority.
